status.description: Auth status only (JSON alias for check)

search.description: Search WeChat Official Accounts by name

info.description: Get account detail (verify status, identity, original_count)

subscribe.description: Add RSS subscription for a WeChat account

unsubscribe.description: Remove RSS subscription and cleanup cached articles

subscriptions.description: List all RSS subscriptions with article counts and RSS URLs

poll.description: Manually trigger full RSS poll for all subscriptions

articles.description: Query cached articles from SQLite with API fallback (Level 4)

fetch.output_mhtml: article.mhtml single-file offline archive with base64 inline images

login.description: Show login page URL and current authentication status

cron-setup.description: Print cron registration guide for both Hermes and OpenCLI
cron-setup.output: Plain text with crontab syntax examples
